description: This file defines the SearchResponse class, which models the structure of a search result including total counts, entries, and facets.

classes.name: SearchResponse
classes.description: A data model representing the response of a search operation, including total count, entries, and facets.

methods.name: setTotalCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of entries found in the search.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of entries found in the search.

methods.name: setEntryCount
methods.description: Sets the number of entries returned in the current page of results.

methods.name: getEntryCount
methods.description: Retrieves the number of entries returned in the current page.

methods.name: setEntries
methods.description: Sets the list of SearchEntry objects representing individual search results.

methods.name: getEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the list of SearchEntry objects.

methods.name: setFacets
methods.description: Sets the map of facet keys to their corresponding list of SearchFacet objects.
